_comment: Fields that exist in Fleet's config.go but are deliberately not in schema.json. Keep a reason next to each.

_reasons.server.sandbox_enabled: Hidden in Fleet (man.hideConfig); Fleet Sandbox no longer exists.
_reasons.server.endpointrequestsizeoverrides: Map-valued (endpoint path to max body size); can't be a form field. Use the Advanced box. (Go has no yaml tag, so the parser sees the lower-cased name.)
